artifact.summary: Single-qubit operation implementing the amplitude-error gate U(epsilon)=RX(pi(1+epsilon)) applied m times in sequence, with no state preparation or measurement. Input validation is done before the circuit is allocated.
register_layout: qubit 0: single data qubit q (least significant bit; computational basis |0>,|1>); no ancilla, no classical bits

equation_mapping.explanation: RX(theta) equals exp(-i theta X/2) exactly, so one gate application is U(epsilon).

equation_mapping.code_location: build_circuit: for loop applying qc.rx(theta, 0) m times
equation_mapping.explanation: The gate is repeated m times with identical coherent error, giving U(epsilon)^m.
Outcome probability cos^2(m pi(1+epsilon)/2) is a property of the circuit's output when measured from |0>. Measurement and input preparation are excluded from the operation.
Empirical shot statistics and binomial variance are sampling and post-processing, not part of the unitary operation.
The Heisenberg-scaling target is an estimation-precision claim for the full protocol, which needs multiple depths and classical post-processing. It is not a circuit.

specification_changes.change: Scope narrowed to the coherent operation U(epsilon)^m only. Measurement, shot sampling, estimator and depth-combination logic are not implemented.
specification_changes.reason: The task requires an operation without measurement or sampling, and the abstract does not give the robust phase-estimation rule.

specification_changes.change: Added validation limits: |epsilon| <= 1 and 1 <= m <= 1024. Each m is a separate instance, not a depth schedule.
specification_changes.reason: Bounds the circuit size and keeps epsilon in the small-error regime. A single depth per circuit is the simplest scope.

assumptions: The amplitude-error model on an X rotation is my own parametrization, not taken from the abstract.
Repetitions are emitted as m separate RX gates rather than one RX(m*theta), so the repeated-gate structure is preserved.
The runner prepares the input state, e.g. |0>, and performs any measurement.
unresolved_issues: The robust Higgins-type phase estimation procedure, its depth schedule and its error bounds are not specified in the abstract and are not implemented.
The off-resonance error model, the universal gate-set sequences and the SPAM-robustness mechanism are not implemented.
No public validation contract was supplied.

validation.detail: Circuit built and transpiled successfully; no independent correctness reference selected.
